title: The Argiros family
excerpt: Editorial research draft about the Argiros family, who founded and ran the Family Foundation School (later Allynwood Academy) in Hancock, New York, from 1984 to 2014. Lawsuit claims are allegations; the family has admitted no wrongdoing.

meta.person_role: Founders and operators of the Family Foundation School / Allynwood Academy, Hancock, New York

person_notable_work: Ran a family-owned 12-step boarding school for 30 years
At least ten Child Victims Act suits and a 2026 federal suit allege abuse there
